name: cape-historical-data
title: Cape Historical Data Repository
description: Records on the Cape Colony, 1660-1891, released by LEAP (Laboratory for the Economics of Africa's Past), Stellenbosch University: cleaned tables of the opgaaf tax censuses (1660-1844, ten districts), the 1834 slave emancipation records, the South African Families genealogies (people born up to 1870), runaway slave advertisements (1830-1842), the 1779 Cape Patriots petition, the Voortrekker register and the Cape almanac directories (1813-1891); yearly prices of goods sold at estate auctions (1718-1813); and the transcription XML of the Orphan Chamber probate inventories (MOOC8) and estate auction rolls (MOOC10). Users must cite the paper(s) for each collection they use (each resource's sources) and this release. Licence CC BY 4.0, except the runaway advertisements (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, the licence of their original deposit). Most of the records are transcriptions of documents held by the Western Cape Archives and Records Service, Cape Town (opgaafrollen, series J; Slave Office, SO 6 and SO 20; Master of the Orphan Chamber, MOOC 8 and MOOC 10; Council of Policy, C 2665), with early tax returns from the Nationaal Archief, The Hague (VOC archive, 1.04.02); the README lists the archival source of each collection. The transcription was funded by Riksbankens Jubileumsfond (the Bank of Sweden Tercentenary Foundation) through the Cape of Good Hope Panel project, grant M20-0041.
